This '''apartment''' was used by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Notluwiski Papanoida/Legends|Notluwiski Papanoida]] and his family during their stay on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]]. It was here that Papanoida's two daughters, [[Che Amanwe Papanoida/Legends|Che Amanwe]] and [[Chi Eekway Papanoida/Legends|Chi Eekway]], were kidnapped by [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]] and a [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] [[Unidentified Gotal bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].
